annotations.title: Screen a business against SBA eligibility rules

description: Screens a business against SBA's published eligibility rules: operating and for-profit, located in the U.S., size standard, ownership and citizenship, ineligible business types (13 CFR 120.110), prior federal loss and delinquent federal debt. Unanswered rules come back as open questions. Each rule cites its source. A rule screen only: not a lender's decision and never approval odds.

annual_receipts.description: Average annual receipts in dollars, including affiliates

associate_incarcerated_or_indicted.description: Is an owner, officer or other associate incarcerated or under indictment for a felony or a crime of financial misconduct or false statement?

average_net_income.description: Average net income after federal income taxes for the prior two fiscal years, in dollars, including affiliates (alternative size standard)

delinquent_federal_debt.description: Does the business or a guarantor owe delinquent federal nontax debt?

description.description: What the business does, in plain words; screened for ineligible types

employees.description: Average number of employees, including affiliates

located_in_us.description: Is it located and operating in the United States or its territories?

naics.description: 6-digit NAICS code of the primary industry (needed to test size)

owners_us_citizens.description: Are 100% of direct and indirect owners and required guarantors U.S. citizens or nationals with their principal residence in the U.S.?

prior_federal_loss.description: Has the business or a business its owners controlled caused a loss to the federal government on a federal loan?

tangible_net_worth.description: Tangible net worth in dollars, including affiliates (alternative size standard)

name: check_eligibility
title: Screen a business against SBA eligibility rules
